sub_sector.value: online health and Medicare insurance brokerage

financial_business_type.detail: Online marketplace and agency selling Medicare Advantage, supplement, and individual health plans for carriers.

revenue_driver.detail: Commissions from insurance carriers on enrolled plans, plus marketing and other fees.

customer_type.detail: Individuals and families, mainly Medicare-eligible seniors, buying health insurance; carriers pay commissions.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Broker earning commissions; carries no underwriting risk.

notes: Website evidence was an error page; facets rely on prior knowledge of eHealth.
